name: Pattern 2: Service
description: Models a service process in which an organization participates and realizes a service provider role; the process generates a service product that realizes a service product role and is linked to a service specification. It applies Pattern 1 to services, giving a structured link between process, participant, roles, output and specification.
competency_questions: Who provides a given service, and what does that service deliver?; Which service makes a given large-scale facility available, and which organization runs that service?; Which service specification does a given data curation, storage, support or training service follow?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
